comparison.objective: Grate at least 5 g of cheese while keeping a box grater upright.
comparison.physical_skill: One arm stabilizes a tool while the other applies normal force and repeated downstrokes.
comparison.success_condition: At least 5 g equivalent from ≥3 N pressed downstrokes, grater upright, cheese placed and arms returned.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization and force regulation are generic. Grating tests repeated sliding contact and material removal, not a discrete calibrated impact, insert retention or debris recovery.
